# Rod Bryans

Rod Bryans is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2011.

Rod Bryans has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rod-bryans#e12)

  Not elected.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rod-bryans#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 45.4% of the ballot.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111017042444/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-helier-district-2/rod-bryans/)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928140515/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=66)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto 2](https://web.archive.org/web/20130201085151/http://rodbryans.com:80/rods-manifesto/)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/rod-bryans#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 with 57% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/rod-bryans/)

## Election History

### 2008 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-2) (3 seats), 26th November 2008.

**Rod Bryans was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Geoff Southern](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geoff-southern)** | [Jersey Democratic Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-democratic-alliance) | 665 | 62.7% |
| 2 | **[Shona Pitman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/shona-pitman)** | [Jersey Democratic Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-democratic-alliance) | 598 | 56.4% |
| 3 | **[Debbie de Sousa](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/debbie-de-sousa)** | [Jersey Democratic Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-democratic-alliance) | 444 | 41.9% |
| 4 | Rod Bryans |  | 412 | 38.9% |
| 5 | [Sue Stoker](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sue-stoker) |  | 301 | 28.4% |
| 6 | [Adrian Walsh](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/adrian-walsh) |  | 228 | 21.5% |
| 7 | [Giffard Aubin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/giffard-aubin) |  | 100 | 9.4% |

1,060 ballots (inc. 4 spoilt papers)

3,821 registered voters

= 27.7% turnout

### 2011 Deputies Election

**Rod Bryans was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 2 in 2011**.
